explanation: Arhangel'skii, 'Selected old open problems in general topology' (BASM 2013, mathnet.ru basm344), Problem 13 (W. Rudin 1956): 'Is it true that every infinite homogeneous compact space contains a non-trivial convergent sequence?' (compact = compact Hausdorff). The formal statement: every infinite compact T2 homogeneous X : Type has an injective sequence converging to some point. An injective convergent sequence is a non-trivial convergent sequence, and conversely any non-trivial convergent sequence has an injective convergent subsequence. HomogeneousSpace is the standard definition. Faithful.
